Hilbert spaces

Source: R/physics-quantum-aaa-qexpr.R
hilbert-spaces.Rd

The Hilbert spaces of sympy.physics.quantum.hilbert: the abstract HilbertSpace(), the finite or infinite ComplexSpace(dimension), the square integrable functions L2(interval) on an Interval(), the Fock space FockSpace(), and the tensor products, direct sums and tensor powers built with *, + and ^ or with the constructors. hs_contains(space, obj) is SymPy's obj in space.

Usage

HilbertSpace()

ComplexSpace(dimension)

L2(interval)

FockSpace()

TensorProductHilbertSpace(...)

DirectSumHilbertSpace(...)

TensorPowerHilbertSpace(base, exp)

hs_contains(space, obj)

Arguments

dimension

A positive integer, oo or a symbol.

interval

An Interval().

...

Hilbert spaces.

base, exp

A Hilbert space and its power.

space

A Hilbert space.

obj

A quantum object.

Value

A Hilbert space, or TRUE/FALSE for hs_contains().

Examples

ComplexSpace(2) * FockSpace()
#> C(2)*F
ComplexSpace(2)^3
#> C(2)^3
qattr(ComplexSpace(2) + FockSpace(), "dimension")
#> oo
